Crouched over a low workbench, coaxing a thumbnail-sized flame to hover just above an open palm, watching it pulse and reshape itself into a slow-spinning ember-rose that sheds sparks like pollen.
A copper kettle drifts in lazy circles near the ceiling, trailing steam that forms rune-shapes before dissolving. Three mugs orbit it slowly, waiting. No one is in the room.
Hunched over a cauldron, stirring counterclockwise with a long bone spoon, each rotation releasing a soft burst of violet light from the surface of the bubbling liquid below.
Kneeling on a woven mat, both hands raised, drawing a luminous geometric sigil in mid-air with two glowing fingertips, the lines hanging suspended and humming faintly.
Peering into a wide obsidian scrying-bowl filled with silver water, nose almost touching the surface, as shifting images of distant landscape drift slowly across its glowing face.
An open spellbook on a lectern turns its own pages in a dim room, each page briefly illuminating the space with soft amber light before the next flips over in silence.
Seated cross-legged on the floor, a small vortex of etheric mist swirling between both cupped hands, slowly being shaped and compressed into a glowing sphere the size of an apple.
Standing at an alchemist's table, tipping a thin glass vial with extreme care, a single drop of luminous green liquid falling in slow motion toward a bubbling flask below.
Bent close to a flat rune-stone resting on a velvet cloth, one finger tracing its carved surface while the rune pulses warm amber in rhythm with the touch.
A quill writes rapidly across parchment on a desk, dipping itself into the inkpot, scratching out line after line of glowing script. The chair is empty. The candle watches.
Leaning back in a tall chair, feet tucked up, reading a grimoire whose pages turn on their own every minute, a small wisp-orb hovering at shoulder height providing the only light.
Standing at the hearth with arms slightly raised, drawing threads of flame out of the fire like pulling taffy, weaving them into a long braid of living fire that hangs in the air.
Measuring a dried silver herb over a glass mortar, pinching precisely, while a floating candlestick hovers nearby to illuminate the scales, its flame angled helpfully toward the measurement.
Dozens of folded paper cranes drift in slow orbits around a ceiling lamp, each one trailing a faint bioluminescent line. The room below is undisturbed. A teacup steams on the table.
Sitting at a cluttered desk, scribing runes with a glowing quill that leaves traces of light in the air above the parchment before settling into dark ink below.
Holding a faceted crystal at eye level, tilting it slowly, watching pulses of deep blue light travel through its interior in patterns that repeat but never quite the same way twice.
Stirring a shallow clay divination-bowl filled with glowing ash, pulling patterns apart and reading them with a tilted head, lips moving slightly as the ash rearranges itself between strokes.
A broom sweeps a stone floor on its own in slow, methodical arcs. Beside it a dustpan skitters forward to catch debris. A single candle floats along the baseboard providing light.
Kneeling beside a low shelf, uncorking a row of small potion flasks one by one, watching the color of the vapor that rises from each before nodding and recorking it.
Standing in the center of the room, arms wide, an enormous constellation-chart rotating slowly in the air around the figure like a paper orrery, glowing lines connecting star to star.
Hunched over a mortar and pestle, grinding with focused intensity, the resulting powder beginning to glow faint gold with each rotation of the pestle, smoke curling up in thin spirals.
Seated at a window, one hand pressed to a fogged pane, watching as frost-rune patterns crawl outward from the fingertips across the glass in intricate branching shapes.
A floating oil lamp drifts slowly from bookshelf to bookshelf, pausing at each spine as if reading titles, tilting slightly toward certain volumes before moving on. The room is empty of people.
Leaning over a workbench, carefully suspending a glowing gem between two copper rods with hovering fingers, studying the light it projects onto the ceiling in shifting geometric blooms.
Sitting very still at the edge of a meditation circle carved into the floor, every rune in the circle lit from within, both hands resting open on knees as motes of light drift slowly upward.

Hunched over a low workbench, one hand cupped upward, coaxing a marble-sized flame to split into three orbiting sparks — each one a different color, hovering in formation while fingertips trace slow circles beneath them.

Kneeling beside a bubbling cauldron, stirring counterclockwise with a bone-handled ladle while violet smoke rises in deliberate spirals, each curl briefly forming a symbol before dissolving into the rafters above.
Seated cross-legged on the floor, a levitating tome drifting at eye level, pages turning themselves one by one while a glowing amber rune traces itself in the air beside each new passage.

Standing at a cluttered table, both hands wrapped around a pulsing obsidian sphere, leaning close as its interior light shifts between deep blue and silver, casting moving shadow-patterns across the ceiling.
A stone room entirely empty — a quill scratching across parchment unaided, an inkpot tilting itself to refill the nib, three wisp-orbs hovering in a slow triangle overhead, providing the only light.
